mehr_demokratie_wagen.name: Dare More Democracy
mehr_demokratie_wagen.desc: Willy Brandt's first government statement promises a society that is more open, more just and more willing to take risks with freedom. The coalition of SPD and FDP holds the chamber by a handful of votes.

voting_age_18.name: Voting Age Eighteen
voting_age_18.desc: Lowering the voting age to eighteen brings a generation shaped by 1968 into the electorate.

bafoeg.name: BAföG
bafoeg.desc: Federal student grants open universities to the children of workers and widen the pool of skilled graduates.

works_constitution.name: Works Constitution Act
works_constitution.desc: The Betriebsverfassungsgesetz of 1972 strengthens works councils on the shop floor.

pension_reform.name: Pension Reform 1972
pension_reform.desc: A flexible retirement age and a minimum pension carry the post-war promise into old age.

family_law_reform.name: Marriage and Family Law Reform
family_law_reform.desc: Divorce moves from guilt to breakdown; the housewife marriage is no longer the law's only model.

codetermination.name: Co-determination 1976
codetermination.desc: Near-parity employee seats on the boards of large companies; the shareholders keep the casting vote, as the FDP insisted.

modell_deutschland.name: Modell Deutschland
modell_deutschland.desc: Helmut Schmidt sells the Federal Republic as a model of crisis management: hard currency, social peace, export strength.

kanalarbeiter.name: Back the Kanalarbeiter
kanalarbeiter.desc: The SPD's right wing - Seeheimer and the old sewer workers - keeps the party on the side of nuclear power and NATO.

juso_left.name: Give the Jusos a Voice
juso_left.desc: Concede ground to the Young Socialists: more state, more peace movement, less certainty for the FDP.

spiritual_moral_turn.name: The Spiritual-Moral Turn
spiritual_moral_turn.desc: Helmut Kohl promises a 'geistig-moralische Wende': consolidation, family, enterprise and loyalty to the West.

kohl_machine.name: The Kohl System
kohl_machine.desc: A chancellor who governs through the party: networks of loyal district chairmen, phone calls and patience.

consolidation_course.name: Consolidation Course
consolidation_course.desc: Cut the deficit, lower corporate taxes, loosen the labour market - the Lambsdorff paper becomes government policy.

pflegeversicherung.name: Long-Term Care Insurance
pflegeversicherung.desc: Norbert Blüm's fifth pillar of social insurance - paid for by abolishing the Day of Repentance and Prayer.

bitburg.name: Bitburg
bitburg.desc: A gesture of reconciliation at a war cemetery that turns out to contain SS graves - popular at home, a scandal in Washington.

freiburg_theses.name: The Freiburg Theses
freiburg_theses.desc: Social liberalism: reformed property, co-determination, environmental protection. The FDP as the conscience of the coalition.

kiel_theses.name: The Kiel Theses
kiel_theses.desc: Back to the market: the FDP rediscovers lower taxes and its business wing - and the Union as a partner.

genscher_foreign_office.name: Genscher at the Foreign Office
genscher_foreign_office.desc: The longest-serving foreign minister in the West: détente without illusions, Western ties without servility.

baum_liberal_interior.name: A Liberal Interior Ministry
baum_liberal_interior.desc: Gerhart Baum reins in the security services: data protection, controls on the BKA, an end to routine vetting.

union_opposition.name: The Union in Opposition
union_opposition.desc: The CDU/CSU lost power by twelve votes and believes it still owns the state. It must decide how to oppose the Eastern treaties.

so_nicht.name: 'Not Like This!'
so_nicht.desc: Barzel's line: no blanket no, but no ratification on these terms. It keeps the Union together - and the expellees on board.

joint_resolution.name: A Joint Resolution
joint_resolution.desc: Accept the treaties with a Bundestag resolution that keeps the German question open - and let the Union abstain.

party_reform_cdu.name: A Members' Party
party_reform_cdu.desc: Under Biedenkopf and Geißler the CDU builds a modern party organisation: 734,000 members by 1983.

csu_bavaria.name: Bavaria First
csu_bavaria.desc: Franz Josef Strauß runs the CSU as a state party with federal ambitions. Keeping him inside the tent costs concessions.

greens_parliament.name: The Greens Enter the Bundestag
greens_parliament.desc: Ecological, social, grassroots-democratic, non-violent: a new party that refuses to behave like one.

realos.name: Realos Take Over
realos.desc: Fischer's pragmatists accept coalitions, budgets and eventually NATO. The fundamentalists leave.

fundis.name: Fundis Hold the Line
fundis.desc: No coalitions, rotation of mandates, exit from NATO. The Greens stay pure - and in opposition.

red_green_hesse.name: Red-Green in Hesse
red_green_hesse.desc: Joschka Fischer is sworn in as environment minister in trainers: the first red-green state coalition.

red_green_federal.name: The Red-Green Project
red_green_federal.desc: A generation that marched against the state now runs it: SPD and Greens form a federal government.

bundesrat_bargaining.name: The Mediation Committee
bundesrat_bargaining.desc: When the Bundesrat is in the hands of the other side, every major law goes through the Vermittlungsausschuss.

federal_president.name: A President Above the Parties
federal_president.desc: Heinemann, Scheel, Carstens, Weizsäcker: the Bundesversammlung previews every change of government.

weizsaecker_speech.name: 8 May 1985
weizsaecker_speech.desc: Richard von Weizsäcker calls the end of the war a day of liberation. The Republic finds a language for its past.

berlin_capital.name: Berlin, Capital
berlin_capital.desc: 338 to 320: the Bundestag votes to move parliament and government from Bonn to Berlin.

asylum_compromise.name: The Asylum Compromise
asylum_compromise.desc: Article 16a: the right to asylum stays, but safe third countries and safe countries of origin are written into the Basic Law.

lebenspartnerschaft.name: Citizenship and Civil Partnerships
lebenspartnerschaft.desc: A modern citizenship law and recognition for same-sex couples: red-green rewrites who belongs.

militant_democracy.name: Militant Democracy
militant_democracy.desc: The Basic Law protects itself: the Federal Constitutional Court can ban parties that fight the free democratic order.

vergangenheitsbewaeltigung.name: Confronting the Past
vergangenheitsbewaeltigung.desc: The Majdanek trial, the 'Holocaust' broadcast of 1979, the abolition of the statute of limitations for murder.

social_market.name: The Social Market Economy at Twenty-Five
social_market.desc: Full employment, a hard Deutschmark and an export surplus - but the miracle years are over and the unions want their share.

concerted_action.name: Concerted Action
concerted_action.desc: Government, employers, unions and the Bundesbank at one table: Karl Schiller's attempt to steer wages and growth together.

bundesbank_independence.name: Respect the Bundesbank
bundesbank_independence.desc: The Bundesbank is independent by law and by conviction. Fighting it costs more than obeying it.

end_bretton_woods.name: Float the Deutschmark
end_bretton_woods.desc: The dollar can no longer hold the system. In 1973 the D-Mark floats - and rises.

public_sector_strike.name: The ÖTV Strike
public_sector_strike.desc: Public-service workers demand double-digit raises in the middle of the oil shock. Willy Brandt's authority is on the line.

stimulus_1975.name: Stimulus Programme
stimulus_1975.desc: Deficit spending against the first post-war recession: investment grants, construction, regional aid.

austerity_1975.name: The Budget Structure Act
austerity_1975.desc: Hold the line: cut subsidies, freeze posts, let the Bundesbank do its work.

locomotive.name: The Locomotive Deal
locomotive.desc: At the Bonn summit of 1978 Germany agrees to pull the world economy - more demand at home, more inflation risk.

ems.name: The European Monetary System
ems.desc: Schmidt and Giscard tie the European currencies to a grid - and the grid to the D-Mark.

export_world_champion.name: Export World Champion
export_world_champion.desc: Machine tools, chemicals and cars: German industry outsells everyone, dollar or no dollar.

working_time_385.name: The 38.5-Hour Week
working_time_385.desc: IG Metall strikes for seven weeks in 1984. The compromise: shorter hours, flexible plants.

neue_heimat_cleanup.name: Clean Up the Union Enterprises
neue_heimat_cleanup.desc: The DGB's housing giant Neue Heimat is rotten. Force a clean liquidation before the scandal eats the SPD.

privatisation_wave.name: Privatisation Wave
privatisation_wave.desc: Sell the federal stakes in VEBA, VIAG, Volkswagen and Lufthansa: about ten billion marks for the treasury.

postal_reform.name: Postal Reform
postal_reform.desc: Split the Bundespost into post, bank and telecom. In 1996 the Deutsche Telekom share becomes the people's stock.

single_market.name: The Single Market
single_market.desc: The Single European Act of 1986 promises goods, capital, services and people without borders by 1992.

monetary_union_offer.name: Monetary Union for the East
monetary_union_offer.desc: The D-Mark comes - or we go to it. One currency for both German states, decided in months.

treuhand.name: The Treuhandanstalt
treuhand.desc: Eight and a half thousand state firms to privatise, restructure or close. The bill arrives with the unemployment.

solidarity_pact.name: The Solidarity Pact
solidarity_pact.desc: The Solidaritätszuschlag, the Fonds Deutsche Einheit and the Länder finance compromise of 1993.

aufbau_ost.name: Aufbau Ost
aufbau_ost.desc: Motorways, telephones, universities, rebuilt city centres: transfer of over a trillion marks.

euro_founder.name: Founder of the Euro
euro_founder.desc: Give up the D-Mark for a currency built in its image - an independent central bank in Frankfurt and the stability pact.

dmark_bloc.name: The D-Mark Bloc
dmark_bloc.desc: If France says no to Maastricht, a smaller hard-currency zone around the D-Mark will do: Benelux, Austria, Denmark.

agenda_reform.name: Standort Deutschland
agenda_reform.desc: High wages, high taxes, high unemployment: the debate on Germany as a business location dominates the 1990s.

guest_worker_policy.name: The Guest Workers Stay
guest_worker_policy.desc: The recruitment stop of 1973 ends the hiring, not the immigration. Families follow; Germany becomes a country of immigration without admitting it.

return_premium.name: Return Premium
return_premium.desc: Pay guest workers 10,500 marks plus 1,500 per child to go home. 250,000 leave; Turkey is not pleased.

research_policy.name: Federal Research Ministry
research_policy.desc: Data processing programmes, nuclear research centres, Max Planck and Fraunhofer: the state as venture capitalist.

airbus.name: Airbus and Ariane
airbus.desc: European champions where national ones failed: Toulouse and Hamburg build airliners, Kourou launches rockets.

microelectronics.name: The Microelectronics Gap
microelectronics.desc: Japan and America lead in chips. A federal programme and Siemens' megabit project try to catch up.

energy_programme.name: The Energy Programme
energy_programme.desc: Away from oil: coal for security, nuclear power for growth, gas from Holland, Norway - and the Soviet Union.

kohlepfennig.name: The Coal Penny
kohlepfennig.desc: A levy on every electricity bill keeps the Ruhr pits open and the miners employed.

century_contract.name: The Century Contract
century_contract.desc: Power utilities commit to burning German hard coal for fifteen years. Security of supply at a premium.

nuclear_buildout.name: Nuclear Build-Out
nuclear_buildout.desc: Biblis, Brokdorf, Grafenrheinfeld: the plan foresees fifty reactors by 1985.

fast_breeder.name: The Plutonium Economy
fast_breeder.desc: Kalkar's fast breeder, the THTR at Hamm, reprocessing at Wackersdorf: prestige projects that may never deliver.

nuclear_moratorium.name: No More New Reactors
nuclear_moratorium.desc: Listen to Wyhl and Brokdorf: finish what is under construction, build nothing new.

gas_for_pipes.name: Gas for Pipes
gas_for_pipes.desc: Mannesmann pipes for Soviet gas, financed by German banks. The first deal of 1970 binds the Ruhr to Siberia.

urengoy.name: The Urengoy Pipeline
urengoy.desc: A 3.4 billion mark credit for a pipeline the Reagan administration wants stopped. Bonn builds it anyway.

waldsterben.name: Forest Dieback
waldsterben.desc: Spiegel headlines and acid rain: the dying forest makes environmental policy a matter for the chancellery.

environment_ministry.name: Environment Ministry
environment_ministry.desc: After Chernobyl the Federal Republic finally has a minister for the environment and reactor safety.

green_dot.name: The Green Dot
green_dot.desc: Packaging must be taken back: the Duales System makes recycling a national habit.

eco_tax.name: Ecological Tax Reform
eco_tax.desc: Tax energy, lower pension contributions: the red-green government's first big bet.

atomkonsens.name: The Nuclear Consensus
atomkonsens.desc: A negotiated exit: every reactor gets a remaining quantity of electricity, none gets a successor.

internal_security.name: Internal Security
internal_security.desc: Students, Palestinians, a new underground calling itself the Red Army Faction. The federal police were built for another age.

bka_expansion.name: Expand the BKA
bka_expansion.desc: Horst Herold's Federal Criminal Police Office triples its staff and buys computers.

inpol.name: INPOL and PIOS
inpol.desc: A computerised wanted list and a database of persons, institutions, objects and items - 'Kommissar Computer'.

dragnet.name: The Computer Dragnet
dragnet.desc: Cross-match utility bills, rental contracts and train tickets until only the terrorist is left.

gsg9.name: Found GSG 9
gsg9.desc: After Munich, Ulrich Wegener builds a counter-terror unit inside the Federal Border Guard.

gsg9_training.name: Training with the SAS
gsg9_training.desc: Exchange with British and Israeli units, stun grenades and night exercises at Hangelar.

gsg9_global.name: A Worldwide Mandate
gsg9_global.desc: GSG 9 can operate wherever a German aircraft or embassy is held, with the host country's consent.

radicals_decree.name: The Radicals Decree
radicals_decree.desc: Every applicant for public service is checked for loyalty to the constitution. Teachers, train drivers, postmen.

no_radicals_decree.name: Trust the Civil Service
no_radicals_decree.desc: No routine vetting: individual cases only. Brandt would later call the decree one of his cardinal mistakes.

verfassungsschutz.name: Counter-Espionage
verfassungsschutz.desc: The HVA has hundreds of agents in the Federal Republic. The Office for the Protection of the Constitution needs more than files.

crown_witness.name: The Crown Witness
crown_witness.desc: Reduced sentences for terrorists who testify. Distasteful to lawyers, effective in court.

data_protection.name: Data Protection
data_protection.desc: The Federal Data Protection Act of 1977 and the census judgment of 1983: informational self-determination becomes a right.

security_state.name: The Security State
security_state.desc: Internment for terrorist sympathisers, an amendment to Article 102, surveillance without a warrant: the ideas floated in the crisis staff of 1977, now put into law.

reconciliation_offer.name: The Kinkel Initiative
reconciliation_offer.desc: Release for prisoners who renounce violence. In April 1992 the RAF answers: it will 'take back the escalation'.

far_right_watch.name: Watch the Far Right
far_right_watch.desc: Wehrsportgruppen, weapons caches, Nazi rock: right-wing violence has been counted as ordinary crime for too long.

after_rostock.name: After Rostock and Solingen
after_rostock.desc: Candle chains of hundreds of thousands, bans on neo-Nazi groups, and a slow admission that the state looked away.

citizen_in_uniform.name: Citizens in Uniform
citizen_in_uniform.desc: Innere Führung: a conscript army of 495,000 that obeys the Basic Law before any order. Twelve divisions on the inner-German border.

army_structure_3.name: Army Structure 3
army_structure_3.desc: Thirty-three brigades, twelve divisions, all assigned to NATO. More armour, more mobility.

leber_modernisation.name: Leber's Modernisation
leber_modernisation.desc: Georg Leber, the bricklayer minister, buys Leopards, Marders and Gepards - and keeps the soldiers' trust.

leopard_2.name: Leopard 2
leopard_2.desc: Krauss-Maffei's new tank enters service in 1979 and becomes the export success of the decade.

army_structure_4.name: Army Structure 4
army_structure_4.desc: Thirty-six brigades, smaller but heavier, with territorial forces for rear defence.

tornado.name: Tornado
tornado.desc: The Panavia multi-role aircraft: Britain, Italy and Germany share the cost of a low-level strike jet.

jaeger_90.name: Jäger 90
jaeger_90.desc: A European fighter for the 1990s. Expensive, late - and politically impossible to cancel.

baltic_navy.name: A Baltic Navy
baltic_navy.desc: Fast attack craft, Type 206 submarines and the F122 frigates: deny the Warsaw Pact the Baltic exits.

type_209.name: The Type 209
type_209.desc: HDW's export submarine sells to a dozen navies. Kiel builds for the world.

nuclear_sharing_role.name: Nuclear Participation
nuclear_sharing_role.desc: Pershing Ia, Lance and Tornados at Büchel: German crews, American warheads, a German voice in NATO's nuclear planning.

national_option.name: The National Option
national_option.desc: Germany signed the NPT but never quite closed the door. A breeder, a reprocessing plant, enriched uranium - and a scandal that would end the Western alliance.

conscription_w15.name: Fifteen Months
conscription_w15.desc: Shorter service, more fairness: conscription is cut to fifteen months.

conscription_w18.name: Eighteen Months
conscription_w18.desc: The baby boom is over; from 1987 the cohorts shrink. Lengthen service or lose divisions.

civilian_service.name: Civilian Service
civilian_service.desc: Conscientious objectors staff hospitals and care homes: 3,900 in 1961, 130,000 by the 1990s.

army_of_unity.name: Army of Unity
army_of_unity.desc: Take over the NVA: keep the MiG-29s, dismiss most of the officers, sell the ships.

army_structure_5.name: Army Structure 5
army_structure_5.desc: 370,000 soldiers, as promised in Moscow. Fewer tanks, more crisis reaction forces.

out_of_area_ruling.name: The Out-of-Area Ruling
out_of_area_ruling.desc: July 1994: Karlsruhe allows armed deployments abroad - with a vote of the Bundestag each time.

kosovo_decision.name: Never Again Auschwitz
kosovo_decision.desc: Joschka Fischer argues for war without a UN mandate. The first German combat mission since 1945.

arms_export_guidelines.name: Arms Export Guidelines
arms_export_guidelines.desc: No weapons to areas of tension - in principle. In practice every chancellor makes exceptions.

atlantic_anchor.name: The Atlantic Anchor
atlantic_anchor.desc: Two hundred thousand American soldiers, the British Army of the Rhine and the French in Baden: the Republic's life insurance.

elysee_revival.name: The Élysée Treaty Revived
elysee_revival.desc: Brandt and Pompidou, Schmidt and Giscard, Kohl and Mitterrand: the Franco-German couple becomes Europe's engine.

ec_enlargement.name: Enlarge the Community
ec_enlargement.desc: Britain, Ireland and Denmark in 1973; Greece, Spain and Portugal once they are democracies.

g7_bonn.name: The Bonn Summit
g7_bonn.desc: The world economic summit comes to the Rhine. Germany is asked to lead - and to pay.

double_track.name: The Double-Track Decision
double_track.desc: Helmut Schmidt warned of the SS-20 gap. NATO answers: negotiate, and if talks fail, deploy Pershing II and cruise missiles in 1983.

deployment_vote.name: Deployment
deployment_vote.desc: 22 November 1983: the Bundestag votes for deployment, 1.3 million demonstrate against it.

no_deployment.name: No to the Missiles
no_deployment.desc: The Bundestag rejects deployment. Washington talks of troop withdrawals, Moscow of a new chapter.

franco_german_brigade.name: The Franco-German Brigade
franco_german_brigade.desc: A joint brigade from 1989, the Eurocorps after 1992: a European pillar inside NATO.

schengen.name: Schengen
schengen.desc: Five countries abolish their common border controls in a Luxembourg village.

maastricht.name: Maastricht
maastricht.desc: European Union, a common currency, a common foreign policy. The French vote yes by 51 percent - or not.

two_plus_four_west.name: Unity Inside NATO
two_plus_four_west.desc: Persuade Washington, London and Paris that a united Germany in NATO is the safest Germany.

checkbook_diplomacy.name: Checkbook Diplomacy
checkbook_diplomacy.desc: The Basic Law forbids sending troops to the Gulf - so Germany pays seventeen billion marks instead.

recognise_croatia.name: Recognise Slovenia and Croatia
recognise_croatia.desc: Genscher pushes the EC to recognise the breakaway republics. Paris and London are furious.

new_ostpolitik.name: The New Ostpolitik
new_ostpolitik.desc: Egon Bahr's formula: change through rapprochement. Accept the realities of 1945 to make them bearable for the people.

erfurt_kassel.name: Erfurt and Kassel
erfurt_kassel.desc: Brandt meets Willi Stoph. Crowds in Erfurt chant 'Willy Brandt ans Fenster!' - the SED is not amused.

moscow_treaty.name: The Moscow Treaty
moscow_treaty.desc: August 1970: renunciation of force and the borders as they are - with a letter on German unity attached.

warsaw_treaty.name: The Warsaw Treaty
warsaw_treaty.desc: The Oder-Neisse line, a kneeling chancellor at the ghetto memorial and the release of ethnic Germans.

berlin_agreement.name: The Quadripartite Agreement
berlin_agreement.desc: The Four Powers guarantee transit to West Berlin. The city is no longer a hostage for every crisis.

ratification.name: Ratify the Eastern Treaties
ratification.desc: Two votes short of losing the chancellorship, the coalition puts the treaties to the Bundestag.

basic_treaty.name: The Basic Treaty
basic_treaty.desc: December 1972: good-neighbourly relations, permanent missions instead of embassies, two states in one nation.

un_membership.name: Two German States at the UN
un_membership.desc: 18 September 1973: both German states join the United Nations.

prague_treaty.name: The Prague Treaty
prague_treaty.desc: The Munich Agreement declared void; diplomatic relations with Czechoslovakia, Hungary and Bulgaria follow.

helsinki.name: Helsinki
helsinki.desc: The CSCE Final Act: borders accepted, human rights written down. Dissidents in the East will hold their rulers to Basket Three.

swing_credit.name: The Swing
swing_credit.desc: An interest-free overdraft for inner-German trade. Raise it and the GDR depends on Bonn a little more.

prisoner_buyouts.name: Buying Freedom
prisoner_buyouts.desc: Since 1963 Bonn has quietly paid for political prisoners - by 1989 about 35,000 at up to 95,000 marks each.

permanent_mission.name: The Permanent Mission
permanent_mission.desc: Günter Gaus in East Berlin: diplomacy without the word embassy, and a refuge for desperate visitors.

billion_credit.name: The Billion-Mark Credit
billion_credit.desc: Strauß, of all people, arranges a state-guaranteed loan for an insolvent GDR. In return: no more self-firing devices on the border.

honecker_visit.name: Honecker in Bonn
honecker_visit.desc: September 1987: the anthem of the GDR on the Rhine. Recognition creep - or a chance to ask for travel freedom?

ten_point_plan.name: The Ten-Point Plan
ten_point_plan.desc: Kohl surprises his allies and his coalition partner: confederative structures, then a federation.

oder_neisse_final.name: The Border Treaty with Poland
oder_neisse_final.desc: No unity without a final border. The expellees protest; Warsaw finally believes Bonn.

unity_treaty.name: The Unification Treaty
unity_treaty.desc: Nine hundred pages that merge two legal systems, two pension systems and two armies.

soviet_withdrawal.name: Pay for the Withdrawal
soviet_withdrawal.desc: Twelve billion marks to house the returning Soviet soldiers. The last leave Berlin on 31 August 1994.

stasi_files.name: Open the Stasi Files
stasi_files.desc: Every citizen may read what the Ministry for State Security wrote about them. The Gauck authority opens in 1992.

wandel_hardline.name: Rechtsposition
wandel_hardline.desc: Stand on the legal position: no recognition, no credits without returns, no illusions about the SED.

renegotiate_treaties.name: Renegotiate the Treaties
renegotiate_treaties.desc: Chancellor Barzel wants the treaties - but with explicit reservations on unity and the rights of expellees.

magnet_theory.name: The Magnet Theory
magnet_theory.desc: Make the West so attractive that the East is drawn to it: no deals, only prosperity and pressure.

cultural_diplomacy.name: Cultural Foreign Policy
cultural_diplomacy.desc: Goethe-Institut, Deutsche Welle, DAAD: the third pillar of foreign policy after security and trade.

munich_olympics.name: The Cheerful Games
munich_olympics.desc: Munich 1972 is meant to show a different Germany: light, colourful, unarmed. The police wear pastel uniforms.

development_ministry.name: The Development Ministry
development_ministry.desc: Erhard Eppler and the BMZ: development aid as partnership - and as Cold War competition.

party_foundations.name: The Party Foundations
party_foundations.desc: Friedrich Ebert for the social democrats, Konrad Adenauer for the Christian democrats: German parties export their politics.

brandt_commission.name: The Brandt Commission
brandt_commission.desc: North-South: a programme for survival. The elder statesman turns to the Global South.

world_cup_1974.name: World Champions 1974
world_cup_1974.desc: Gerd Müller turns, shoots, scores in Munich. Beckenbauer lifts the cup - and the GDR beats the West in Hamburg.

olympic_boycott.name: Boycott Moscow?
olympic_boycott.desc: After Afghanistan, Washington asks its allies to stay away from the 1980 Olympics. The Bundestag says yes.

middle_east_balance.name: Balance in the Middle East
middle_east_balance.desc: Special relations with Israel, oil and markets in the Arab world. Every chancellor walks the line.

critical_dialogue.name: Critical Dialogue with Iran
critical_dialogue.desc: Trade with Tehran, talk about human rights. Then the Mykonos restaurant murders are traced to the Iranian state.

expo_2000.name: Expo 2000
expo_2000.desc: Hanover hosts the world exhibition: humankind, nature, technology - and fewer visitors than hoped.

barzel_cabinet.name: Chancellor Barzel
barzel_cabinet.desc: Two votes made Rainer Barzel chancellor. He must govern with defectors and a Bundesrat that likes him better than the Bundestag does.

barzel_west_first.name: West First
barzel_west_first.desc: Ostpolitik yes, but only with American blessing and a written claim to unity.

barzel_social_market.name: Social Market, Not Reform State
barzel_social_market.desc: Stop the expensive reforms, keep the pension promise.

csu_nationwide.name: The Fourth Party
csu_nationwide.desc: Kreuth holds: the CSU stands everywhere, the CDU founds a Bavarian branch. Two Union parties fight for the same voters - or for different ones.

cdu_centre_course.name: The CDU Moves to the Centre
cdu_centre_course.desc: Without the CSU's right flank, the CDU courts the FDP and the moderate SPD voter.

strauss_model.name: The Bavarian Model
strauss_model.desc: Chancellor Strauß: aerospace, nuclear power, low taxes and a loud voice in Washington.

strauss_aerospace.name: MBB and Airbus
strauss_aerospace.desc: Strauß chairs the Airbus supervisory board and wants a German aerospace champion.

strauss_east_credit.name: The Surprising Credit
strauss_east_credit.desc: The anti-communist arranges the loan for Honecker. Only Nixon could go to China.

schmidt_minority.name: Schmidt Governs Alone
schmidt_minority.desc: The FDP has left, the chancellor stays. A minority government in Bonn is a novelty - and a countdown.

schmidt_snap_election.name: Let the Voters Decide
schmidt_snap_election.desc: Ask for the confidence of the house, lose it on purpose and go to the people.

spaeth_high_tech.name: Späth's High-Tech State
spaeth_high_tech.desc: The Baden-Württemberg model goes federal: research parks, venture capital, Daimler and Bosch.

spaeth_slow_unity.name: Unity Without Haste
spaeth_slow_unity.desc: Chancellor Späth will not promise blooming landscapes. Step by step, mark by mark.

lafontaine_keynes.name: The Saarland Keynesian
lafontaine_keynes.desc: Chancellor Lafontaine: lower interest rates, more public investment, a quarrel with the Bundesbank.

lafontaine_cautious_unity.name: Count the Cost of Unity
lafontaine_cautious_unity.desc: Lafontaine warned that unity would be paid for by taxes. Now he must prove it can be done cheaper.

grand_coalition.name: A Grand Coalition
grand_coalition.desc: When neither camp has a majority, the two big parties govern together - and the small ones grow.

steel_crisis.name: The Steel Crisis
steel_crisis.desc: Saar and Ruhr steelworks lose to Japan and Korea. Mergers, subsidies and the first long strike in the steel industry.

ruhr_structural_change.name: Structural Change in the Ruhr
ruhr_structural_change.desc: Universities instead of pits, services instead of blast furnaces: Nordrhein-Westfalen reinvents itself, slowly.

shipyard_crisis.name: The Shipyard Crisis
shipyard_crisis.desc: AG Weser closes in 1983. Bremen and Kiel ask Bonn for money.

vocational_training.name: The Dual System
vocational_training.desc: Apprenticeships in firm and school: the quiet strength of German industry, and an export product of its own.

housing_programme.name: Social Housing
housing_programme.desc: Satellite towns at the edge of every big city: modern in 1972, problem estates by 1985.

tax_reform_1990.name: The Stoltenberg Tax Reform
tax_reform_1990.desc: Lower rates in three stages, the largest tax cut in the Republic's history so far.

petersberg_reform.name: The Petersberg Reform
petersberg_reform.desc: A great tax reform for 1998 - blocked in the Bundesrat by Lafontaine's SPD majority.

chernobyl_response.name: After Chernobyl
chernobyl_response.desc: A radioactive cloud over Bavaria, contaminated milk, a run on iodine tablets.

renewable_research.name: Solar and Wind Research
renewable_research.desc: Growian, the giant wind turbine, fails. Its lessons do not.

feed_in_law.name: The Feed-In Law
feed_in_law.desc: 1990: utilities must buy wind and solar power at a fixed price. A backbench law with a long future.

stammheim_trial.name: The Stammheim Trial
stammheim_trial.desc: A purpose-built courtroom next to the prison, defence lawyers excluded, a hunger strike that kills Holger Meins.

paragraph_129a.name: Paragraph 129a
paragraph_129a.desc: Membership of - or support for - a terrorist organisation becomes a crime of its own.

contact_ban_law.name: The Contact Ban Act
contact_ban_law.desc: Passed in days during the Schleyer kidnapping: prisoners may be cut off even from their lawyers.

ban_wsg.name: Ban the Wehrsportgruppe
ban_wsg.desc: Karl-Heinz Hoffmann's paramilitary group trains in uniform in the Franconian woods. Ban it.

ban_pkk.name: Ban the PKK
ban_pkk.desc: Arson attacks on Turkish institutions, motorway blockades: in November 1993 the PKK is banned.

bundeswehr_universities.name: Bundeswehr Universities
bundeswehr_universities.desc: Officers study in Hamburg and Munich: an educated officer corps for a democratic army.

patriot.name: Patriot and Roland
patriot.desc: Air defence against the Warsaw Pact's air armies: Patriot batteries from 1989.

nato_awacs.name: AWACS at Geilenkirchen
nato_awacs.desc: NATO's own airborne radar fleet is based in Germany - with German crews aboard.

f122_frigates.name: Bremen-Class Frigates
f122_frigates.desc: Eight F122 frigates for the North Sea and the Atlantic. The Marine leaves the Baltic behind.

tornado_ecr.name: Tornado ECR
tornado_ecr.desc: Electronic combat Tornados with HARM missiles: Germany's contribution to NATO air campaigns.

home_defence.name: Territorial Army
home_defence.desc: Heimatschutz brigades of reservists to hold the rear while the field army fights at the border.

mbfr.name: Mutual and Balanced Force Reductions
mbfr.desc: Vienna, 1973 to 1989: sixteen years of talks about fewer soldiers in Central Europe.

political_cooperation.name: European Political Cooperation
political_cooperation.desc: The Nine coordinate their foreign policy - at Helsinki, on the Middle East, at the UN.

nato_enlargement.name: NATO Opens to the East
nato_enlargement.desc: Poland, Czechia and Hungary join in 1999. Germany is no longer the frontline.

uruguay_round.name: The Uruguay Round
uruguay_round.desc: Free trade in goods and services, a World Trade Organization - and a fight with French farmers.

west_media_strategy.name: Western Television for the East
west_media_strategy.desc: ARD and ZDF reach the whole GDR except the 'valley of the clueless' around Dresden. Every evening the West comes in.

church_contacts.name: Church to Church
church_contacts.desc: The Protestant churches in East and West never fully split. Their meetings shelter the GDR's peace and environment groups.

travel_relief.name: Travel Relief
travel_relief.desc: Pensioners may visit the West, family visits for urgent matters, and the minimum exchange - negotiated down or not.

embassy_refugees.name: Refugees in the Embassies
embassy_refugees.desc: East Germans climb the fences of the West German embassies in Prague, Budapest and Warsaw. Every one of them is a citizen of the Federal Republic.

support_round_table.name: Support the Round Table
support_round_table.desc: Money, advisers and printing presses for the new parties of the GDR - quietly, through the party foundations.

treaty_community.name: Treaty Community
treaty_community.desc: Modrow's offer: a contractual community between two states, then confederation. Unity in years, not months.

art146_debate.name: A New Constitution?
art146_debate.desc: Article 146: the Basic Law ends when the German people adopt a constitution in free decision. Draft one together.

neutral_offer.name: Unity for Neutrality?
neutral_offer.desc: Stalin offered it in 1952. If Moscow offers it again, should Bonn take it?

crackdown_response.name: After the Massacre
crackdown_response.desc: The SED has fired on its own people. Sanction the regime, or keep the channels open for the prisoners' sake?

second_cold_war.name: Cold War Again
second_cold_war.desc: The coup in Moscow has succeeded or the Soviets have said no. Divided Germany prepares for a long winter.

israel_relations.name: The Special Relationship
israel_relations.desc: Reparations, arms deliveries in secret, diplomatic relations since 1965: Israel's security as a German interest.

brazil_nuclear_deal.name: The Brazil Nuclear Deal
brazil_nuclear_deal.desc: Eight reactors, enrichment and reprocessing for a military regime. Washington protests, Siemens signs.

africa_development.name: Development Partnerships
africa_development.desc: Wells, roads and vocational schools from Tanzania to Togo - and a competition with the GDR's advisers.

un_security_council.name: A Seat at the Security Council
un_security_council.desc: Non-permanent member in 1977-78 and 1987-88 - and from 1990 the quiet campaign for a permanent seat.

world_cup_1990.name: World Champions 1990
world_cup_1990.desc: Rome, Andreas Brehme's penalty, Beckenbauer walking alone across the pitch: champions in the year of unity.
